response.overview: The protagonist is a 19 year old, who is deeply passionate about cinema and is a true movie buff. His elder sister got married and left home a week ago, leaving him alone. He lost his mother two years ago.  One day, he orders a pizza. As he sits down to eat, he hears an unexpected tapping sound coming from the kitchen faucet. What initially seems like an ordinary disturbance gradually becomes something much deeper, as the sound holds an emotional and metaphorical significance in his life.  The film unfolds as a thriller that slowly transitions into an emotional story, with the true meaning behind the tap leak sound and its impact on the protagonist being revealed in the climax.
response.title: PIZZA
